reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is physically inconsistent: a 21 Å thick coating is only ~6 atomic layers, making bulk concepts like dislocation nucleation at vacancy clusters and Shockley partial-mediated plasticity inapplicable, and the predicted sharp drop in wear resistance above 900 K contradicts the known high-temperature stability of FeNiCrCoCu HEA.
reasons.testability: The proposed falsification test is circular (it merely checks if the predicted outcome occurs) and the simulation setup is too idealized (ultra-thin film, single-crystal substrate, unrealistic indentation speed) to provide a decisive test of the hypothesis for a real coating.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a physically unrealistic model system and does not address the actual question of what governs wear resistance in a real HEA coating at high temperature.
